mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the eyes to the nervous system clarified that sight helps locate an object while muscles provide movement force. That distinction makes the reach easier to understand.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the arm to the nervous system was predictable after the new goal appeared, although the result added useful information about position feedback.

surprise.text: Signals from the body also report the arm's position. The result does not explain what detects that position or how the feedback travels.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt purposeless, but each decision offered only one combination, so I followed the available route rather than figuring out compatibility.

continue.text: I would be interested in one more chapter to see how the muscles receive their continuing supplies, especially if it explains the missing steps as clearly as the sight and movement distinction.
